newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.48 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.48 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed unchanged at 14.48 ringgit ($5.83) a kg on support at lower levels, despite an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There were too much offers at the initial but support came in at the lower levels later," said a trader.

Buyers from Europe, Japan and Malaysia matched positions with sellers for a final turnover of 135 tonnes, against 93 on Thursday. The local price differential against the LME remained at a discount of $20, said traders.
